root_cause: CI Calibration produced bounded read-only recommendations while the daily Autonomous Engineering Optimizer made protected tuning decisions independently. The two feedback loops could therefore disagree and allow upward tuning while calibration still observed a high-priority CI risk.
prevention_rule: Feed calibration recommendations into the optimizer only as advisory safety evidence. High-priority calibration may veto upward parallelism/speculation, but cannot directly mutate tuning. All tuning remains bounded to the existing safe allowlist and persists only through the protected optimizer PR.

evidence.authority: Calibration remains SHADOW_RECOMMENDATIONS and safe_to_apply_automatically=false; optimizer retains protected-candidate-only mutation path.
